# Evaluate differential expression.
```{r}
clump = function(agg_data, comparison, cell_type) {
    metadata = colData(agg_data)[,c("group", "metacell")]
    metadata$group = factor(metadata$group, levels = c("control", comparison)) # Establish to get the order we want.

    dds = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(assay(agg_data, "counts")), 
                    colData = metadata, 
                    design = ~ group)
    
    keep = rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= nrow(metadata) * 0.85  # at least 85% of metacells that have at least 10 transcripts    
    dds = dds[keep,]
    dds = DESeq(dds)
    res = results(dds, contrast = c("group", comparison, "control"))

    res_ordered_wald = res[order(res$padj),] %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene")
    write_tsv(res_ordered_wald, paste0("tables/metacells_de/", comparison, "_", cell_type, ".tsv"))
    return(res_ordered_wald)
}



run_comparisons = function(comparison, cases, controls, cell_type, counts) {
  
  get_data = function(sample_id, cell_type, group) {
    file = paste0("tables/metacells_output/", sample_id, "_", cell_type, "_metacells.csv")
    data = read_csv(file) %>%
      mutate(sample_metacell = sample_id) %>%
      mutate(group = group)
  }
  
  control_data_list = lapply(controls, get_data, cell_type, "control")
  control_metadata = do.call("rbind", control_data_list)
  
  case_data_list = lapply(cases, get_data, cell_type, comparison)
  case_metadata = do.call("rbind", case_data_list)
 
  metadata = rbind(case_metadata, control_metadata) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cell_barcode = `...1`) %>%
    filter(metacell >= 0) # negative metacell assignments given to outliers
  
  if(sum(metadata %>% filter(group != "Control") %>% pull(metacell) >= 0) < 1) {
    print("Insufficient high quality metacells.")
    return()
  }

  counts_subset = counts@counts[,metadata$cell_barcode] # this syntax changes for seurat v4 and seurat v5 (counts vs counts@counts)
  rownames(metadata) = metadata$cell_barcode

  sce = SingleCellExperiment(counts_subset, colData = metadata)
  assayNames(sce) = "counts"

  agg_data = aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = colData(sce)[,c("group", "metacell")])
  comparison = clump(agg_data, comparison = comparison, cell_type = cell_type) 

}


```


```{r}
annotated_11994_seu = readRDS("rds_objects/5_annotated_11994_monocytes.rds")
counts = annotated_11994_seu@assays$RNA

# TET2
run_comparisons(comparison = "TET2", cases = c("5001"), controls = c("5003", "5013", "5029", "5037", "5038"), cell_type = "circulating_cd14+_monocytes", counts = counts)
# DNMT3A
run_comparisons(comparison = "DNMT3A", cases = c("5011"), controls = c("5003", "5013", "5029", "5037", "5038"), cell_type = "circulating_cd14+_monocytes", counts = counts)
```

```{r}
save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}

```

# Plot volcanos.
```{r}
format_volcano = list(
  xlab("decreased in CHIP log2(fold change) increased in CHIP"),
  ylab("-log10(p-value)"),
  guides(color = guide_legend("Function")),
  theme_bw(),
  theme_classic(),
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 12.5),
        title = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.key.size = unit(0, "lines")),
  scale_color_manual(values = c("slateblue", brewer.pal(12, "Paired")[6], "darkgrey"))
)


# function for adding labels
gene_labels = function(data, direction, xlim, ylim, few = FALSE) {
  sorted_data = data %>% 
    arrange(desc(`-log10_p_val`)) %>%
    filter(`-log10_p_val` > -log10(0.05)) %>%
    filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.25) %>%
    head(10)
  if (few) {
    sorted_data = head(sorted_data, 3)
  }
  if (direction == "pos") {
    xlims = c(xlim - 0.5, xlim + 0.5)
  } else {
    xlims = c(-xlim - 0.5, -xlim + 0.5)
  }
  labels = geom_label_repel(data = sorted_data, mapping = aes(label = gene), size = 3, fill = NA, direction = "y", max.overlaps =  Inf, nudge_x = 0.05, segment.alpha = 0.25, force_pull = 0, xlim = xlims, ylim = c(ylim / 5, ylim), show.legend = FALSE, box.padding = 0, segment.linetype = "solid", label.size = 0.08, segment.curvature = ifelse(direction == "neg", -1e-40, 1e-40))
  return(list(labels))
}

# function for making plot
make_volcano_plots = function(cell_type, comparison, x_limit = 1.5, few = FALSE, rds = FALSE, title = "", standard_y_limit = NA) {

  folder = "tables/metacells_de/"
  filename = paste0(comparison, "_", cell_type, ".tsv")
  path_to_file = paste0(folder, filename)
  
  data = read_tsv(paste0(path_to_file)) %>%
    mutate(`-log10_p_val` = -log10(padj))
  
  # sometimes the most significant p-value is 0, which results in an infinite value after log transformation
  # if that is the case, these lines convert the value to the highest possible value
  if (any(data$`-log10_p_val` == Inf)) {
    data$`-log10_p_val`[data$`-log10_p_val` == Inf] = 292
  } 
  
  y_limit = max(data$`-log10_p_val`) * 1.1
  
  data$label_group = NA
  data$label_group[data$gene %in% tem_genes] = "Transendothelial migration"
  data$label_group[data$gene %in% hla_genes] = "HLA"
  data$label_group = factor(data$label_group, levels = c("Transendothelial migration", "HLA", NA))
  
  data_pos = data %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0)
  data_neg = data %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0)
  buffer = 5
  
  highlight_list = c(tem_genes, hla_genes)
  data_pos = data_pos %>% filter(gene %in% c(highlight_list, head(data_pos, 7) %>% pull(gene)))
  data_neg = data_neg %>% filter(gene %in% c(highlight_list, head(data_neg, 7) %>% pull(gene)))
  
  title = ifelse(title == "", gsub("_", " ", gsub(".tsv", "", path_to_file)), title)
  
  # render plot
  plot = ggplot(data %>% arrange(gene %in% highlight_list), aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = `-log10_p_val`, color = label_group)) +
      geom_point() +
      format_volcano +
      xlim(-x_limit, x_limit) +
      ylim(0, ifelse(!is.na(standard_y_limit), standard_y_limit, y_limit)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "longdash", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "longdash", alpha = 0.5) +
      gene_labels(data = data_pos, direction = "pos", xlim = x_limit, ylim = y_limit, few) +
      gene_labels(data = data_neg, direction = "neg", xlim = x_limit, ylim = y_limit, few) +
      ggtitle(title)
  
  print(plot)
  
  output_filename = paste0("figures/volcanos/", gsub(".tsv", "", filename))
  save_plot(plot, output_filename, height = 4, width = 6.5, png = TRUE)
}

# EXECUTE -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_volcano_plots("circulating_cd14+_monocytes", "TET2", title = "Circulating CD14+ monocytes TET2 vs control", standard_y_limit = 60, x_limit = 2)
make_volcano_plots("circulating_cd14+_monocytes", "DNMT3A", title = "Circulating CD14+ monocytes DNMT3A vs control", standard_y_limit = 60, x_limit = 2)
```
